observations: Spec-consistent corner, not requested: a request still carrying the pre-recovery secret S0 when a second daemon restart's recovery R2 is already in flight takes the 'newer secret known' branch (L140) and retries with S1 — the secret R2 exists because it was refused — instead of awaiting R2. The spec orders those branches this way; reaching it needs two restarts inside one request's window. Awaiting an in-flight recovery before returning latestSecret would dominate if the spec is ever revisited.
